summary: Iter3 E2E testing of Revenge Arc major refactor. Backend: 52/52 pytest cases pass (19 baseline + 8 iter2 + 25 new iter3 covering sender no-reply@revengearc.com, /api/config/public support email, /api/admin/stats all 8 time ranges (24h/2d/7d/14d/30d/3mo/6mo/1y) with bucketed growth arrays of correct length, /api/admin/recipient-counts with iphone_users+android_users+everyone, /api/admin/creators?status= filtering, creator-applications WITHOUT compensation_type field, /api/admin/announce for iphone_users/android_users/custom with dedupe + empty-custom=422, templates full CRUD + auth guard). Frontend validated on /: Navbar shows Features dropdown with all 9 feature links (Home Dashboard, Nutrition, AI Food Scan, Gym Buddie AI, Workout Planner, Combat Zone, Arena, Progress Hub, Profile), Pricing ($191.88 strikethrough -> $115.99/yr + 'BEST VALUE SAVE $75.89'), AI Food Scan section shows AI Confidence 85% + 5 feature cards (Total Nutrition 1200kcal, AI Confidence, Items Breakdown 2 items, Portion Estimate, Macro Insight), Creator form has NO 'Compensation Type' label and shows placeholder 'What type of compensation are you looking for?', Footer contains RevengeArkHelp@gmail.com + internal links to /terms, /privacy, /refund, /contact, /support. All 5 legal pages load with proper Revenge Arc themed shell, 'Back home' link. Terms contains AI/fitness/health/disclaimer text. Privacy mentions Firebase/AI/creator/waitlist. Admin: login with RevengeArc2026! works, range selector renders all 8 time-range pills (24h/2d/7d/14d/30d/3mo/6mo/1y), 30d click highlights and updates chart.

minor.endpoint: Iter1/Iter2 test files had stale assertions (growth_14d->growth; support@revengearc.com->RevengeArkHelp@gmail.com) now updated. Not server bugs.

action_items: Main agent should self-verify two admin flows the testing agent did NOT fully walk through end-to-end due to SPA tab-navigation timing in Playwright script (not a product bug — all feature code is present and visually rendered in earlier iterations): (1) Admin > Creators tab 4-pill filter counts & View modal showing every creator field (full_name/email/phone/instagram/tiktok/desired_pay/why_support/audience) with 'Send Custom Email' button; (2) Admin > Broadcast tab with all 7 recipient cards + custom-chip backspace/X + template SAVE/load/delete + send-email-from-creator-row -> /admin/dashboard?tab=broadcast&recipients=<email> prefill. Backend endpoints for all of these are fully verified (25/25 iter3 tests pass).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 575 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Recommend extracting models/, routes/admin.py, routes/public.py, email/renderer.py modules before next feature wave.

Announcement.recipient_group uses Pydantic Literal union ✓. custom_recipients typed as List[EmailStr] which will 422 on malformed input at validation layer — good (caught 'invalid emails' at API boundary, not silently dropped in _collect_recipients).
_collect_recipients dedupe uses set of lowercased emails including custom branch — verified by iter3 test_custom_dedupe_and_invalid_filter (valid1 + valid1.upper() + valid2 -> total=2).
_bucket_starts: hour/day/week/month bucket generation verified across all 8 ranges returns exact expected counts (24/2/7/14/30/12/24/12).
All MongoDB projections exclude _id. ✓ All env vars sourced from os.environ. ✓ Admin auth enforced on every /api/admin/* route via Depends(require_admin). ✓
on_event('shutdown') deprecated by FastAPI — non-blocking but worth migrating to lifespan handler.
Frontend ESLint not run by testing agent but would catch any obvious JSX issues — landing page + 5 legal pages load without runtime errors per browser console check.

success_rate.frontend: 100% verified on Landing + all 5 legal pages + Admin login/overview range selector; Creators tab filters/View modal and Broadcast 7-recipient flow were not walked end-to-end in Playwright due to SPA navigation timing (not a product failure — features render correctly based on DOM inspection)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST3_-prefixed waitlist entries (iPhone + Android) and one creator-application without compensation_type field to exercise the new desired_pay-only schema. Triggered TEST3 announce broadcasts to iphone_users, android_users, and custom groups. Created + updated + deleted a TEST3 template to exercise templates CRUD.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/ (3 files, 52 cases, all passing). Iter3 exhaustively covers new endpoints: /api/admin/stats with all 8 range keys, /api/admin/recipient-counts 6-field response (waitlist/creator_applicants/approved_creators/iphone_users/android_users/everyone), /api/admin/announce recipient_group='custom' with dedupe + EmailStr validation, /api/admin/creators?status= filter, /api/admin/templates CRUD + auth. Use TEST3_-prefixed unique emails. The compensation_type field has been REMOVED from the CreatorCreate schema but Pydantic default extra='ignore' means old callers passing compensation_type still succeed (field silently dropped). /admin/dashboard?tab=broadcast&recipients=email1,email2 is the documented prefill URL format for the Send-Email-from-Creator-row flow.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two pre-existing test assertions were stale from iter1/iter2 (growth_14d->growth rename, support@revengearc.com->RevengeArkHelp@gmail.com email-shell change) and were fixed in this iteration. These were test-side drift, not product regressions.
